sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
HR/Payroll module employees ka pura record rakhta hai — joining se salary tak. Hotel staff (front desk, housekeeping, kitchen, security) ki details, leave, overtime, loan/advance aur monthly salary generation yahin se hoti hai.

HR FLOW: Employee join karo (Employee Master) → Attendance/Leave/Overtime entries chalti rehti → Month end pe Salary Creation (earnings - deductions = net pay) → Loan/advance adjustments salary me.

rows: HR Parameter, Designation, Employee Category, Employee Master, Holiday Master

subsections.title: Key Benefits
bullets: Leave balance tracking with holidays calendar

subsections.title: 2.1 HR Parameter
subsections.paragraph: Payroll ke global rules — salary heads (Basic, HRA, PF, ESI), pay period, rounding, PF/ESI percentages. Ye salary calculation ka base hai.

subsections.title: 2.2 Designation & Employee Category
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ HR/Payroll ▶ Designation / Emp. Category
subsections.paragraph: Designation (Manager, Supervisor, Housekeeper, Chef) aur Category (Permanent, Contract, Part-time, Probation) masters — employee entry me yahi select hota hai.

rows: GM, Front Office Manager, Housekeeper, Cook, Security Guard

subsections.title: 2.3 Employee Master
subsections.paragraph: Har employee ka complete record — personal details, joining date, department, designation, salary structure, bank details, documents. Excel import/export bhi hota hai.

rows: Name, DOB, gender, mobile, address, ID proof
Department, designation, category, joining date, shift
Basic, HRA, other heads, PF/ESI applicable

subsections.title: 2.4 Holiday Master
subsections.paragraph: Saal ke holidays declare karo — leave calculation aur overtime (holiday pe kaam) me use hota hai.

subsections.title: 3.1 Leave Entry
subsections.paragraph: Employee ki leave record karo — date range, leave type (CL/EL/SL/LWP). Salary creation me approved leave ka impact automatic hota hai (LWP = deduction).

subsections.title: 3.2 Overtime Entry
subsections.paragraph: Extra ghanton ka record — employee, date, OT hours. Salary me OT rate (parameter based) se earning add hoti hai.

subsections.title: 4.1 Loan & Advance Entry
subsections.navPath: HR/Payroll ▶ Payroll Entries ▶ Loan Advance Entry
subsections.paragraph: Employee ko diya gaya loan ya advance — amount, EMIs, recovery start month. Salary creation me EMI auto-deduct hota hai jab tak pura na ho jaye.

subsections.title: 4.2 Salary Creation — Month End Process
subsections.paragraph: Monthly salary generate karo: month select karo → system earnings (basic/HRA + OT) aur deductions (leave LWP, PF/ESI, loan EMI) auto-calculate karta hai → verify → Save/Post. Payslips print ready hote hain. Finance me salary expense posting bhi hoti hai.
steps: Leave + OT + Loan entries verify karo (auto-filled)
Save & Post — payslip print / bank transfer list
